cc:Work.dc:title: ISO 5457:1999 A1 template
cc:Work.dc:description: Technical product diagram A1 template. Drawing area and reference dimensions specified by ISO 5457:1999(en). Title block specified by ISO 7200:2004(en). Font is ISO 3098-compliant "osifont" ( https://tracker.debian.org/pkg/fonts-osifont ).
